The 10 minutes before school. ⏰ Watch the same morning, two ways.

Morning 1: 7:50, the same lost shoe. Mom's on her phone. At 7:58, Ella walks through the school doors with Mom's last words in her head: "What is WRONG with you?" 😞

Morning 2: same 7:50, same lost shoe, but this time:
✅ Phone down, eyes up. 👀
✅ Speak life. "I believe in you."
✅ Ask one real question.
✅ Snapped? Repair it. 🩹
✅ Tell her mistakes are okay. She doesn't have to be the smartest or the fastest.
✅ Send her out loved. "I love you!" ❤️

At 10:00, she gets a math question wrong. 8 × 7 = 54. ✏️ Which voice goes with her?

You can't walk the hallway with her. But God can. "It is the LORD who goes before you. He will be with you; he will not leave you or forsake you. Do not fear or be dismayed." Deuteronomy 31:8 (ESV) 🙏

Ten minutes won't fix everything. But it decides the voice your child walks in with. ❤️ And for some kids, that school gate is the scariest part of the day.
